name: core-runtime-database-batch-async-tail-api67
notes: Exact sealed-candidate executable lifecycle witness for Batchable callbacks, live BatchableContext IDs, passive BatchableContextImpl construction, and executeBatch(Object). The rejected Database.Batchable interface constructor is intentionally not claimed.
salesforceExclusionReason: The sealed local runner directly drains Batchable lifecycle and passive context contracts; this async test fixture carries zero hosted Salesforce parity.

source.content: public class DatabaseBatchAsyncTailProbe implements Database.Batchable<Account> { public Database.QueryLocator start(Database.BatchableContext context) { System.assertNotEquals('', context.getJobId()); System.assertEquals(null, context.getChildJobId()); insert new Account(Name = 'Batch-tail-start'); return Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Batch-tail-seed\''); } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext context, List<Account> scope) { System.assertNotEquals('', context.getJobId()); insert new Account(Name = 'Batch-tail-execute'); } public void finish(Database.BatchableContext context) { System.assertNotEquals('', context.getJobId()); insert new Account(Name = 'Batch-tail-finish'); } }

@isTest private class DatabaseBatchAsyncTailFixtureTest { @isTest static void drainsBatchLifecycleAndPassiveContext() { insert new Account(Name = 'Batch-tail-seed'); Database.BatchableContextImpl passive = new Database.BatchableContextImpl(); System.assertEquals('', passive.getJobId()); System.assertEquals('', passive.getChildJobId()); Test.startTest(); String jobId = Database.executeBatch(new DatabaseBatchAsyncTailProbe()); Test.stopTest(); System.assertNotEquals('', jobId); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Batch-tail-start']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Batch-tail-execute']); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Batch-tail-finish']); } }
